title: Conformance fixture
description: One test vector in packages/verifiable-receipts/conformance/fixtures. Its inputs may be malformed on purpose, so this schema constrains only the fixture's frame; expected.ok says whether every verifier must accept it.

publicKeyPem.description: A key fixture's own Ed25519 public key (PEM, SPKI), used instead of public-key.pem.

receiptText.description: A receipt given as JSON text, for what parsing the fixture would lose, such as a duplicate key.

ed25519.description: One Ed25519 signature, checked with each language's strict Ed25519 verification (VAOS 2.0 section 7.3): the raw public key, the message and the signature (R || S), as lowercase hex.
